notes: The hidden Panel Editor tabs stay hidden. Hiding an element relies on a browser default rule that any styling of its own overrides, and the tab buttons are styled as flexible boxes - so their contents disappeared while the buttons…

OLED burn-in protection has a control again, under Window then Behaviour, with a line underneath saying what was actually detected on your displays. The feature was running with nothing to show or change it, because its only control lived…

Choosing a monitor no longer resizes the OG Widget to fill that screen. The check for which panels are widgets read information that was only ever loaded for the Foundation Panel, so for every other panel it answered no and resized anyway.
